Sandbox_PlayIt_SkillEnabled_tooltip: Off: nobody blunders because of low skill and no Music XP is gained. Being drunk or panicked still causes blunders.
Sandbox_PlayIt_BlunderLevel0_tooltip: Chance that a note goes wrong for a complete beginner.
Sandbox_PlayIt_BlunderLevel10_tooltip: Chance that a note goes wrong for a master. Levels in between fall slowly at first and faster near the top (about 6%% at level 5 with the default values).
Sandbox_PlayIt_BlundersAnnoy_tooltip: Wrong notes raise the stress and unhappiness of everyone in earshot (not the musician), but no further than mildly Unhappy and Anxious.
Sandbox_PlayIt_MusicXP_tooltip: Used instead of the global XP multiplier when that one is turned off (per-skill multipliers).
Sandbox_PlayIt_NoiseMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies how far zombies and animals notice the music. 0 = they never do.
